description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelDeleteButton class, a widget responsible for rendering a delete button in subpanels within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It includes a method to generate the HTML for the delete link, handling specifics like module context, record identification, and display text.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelDeleteButton
classes.description: A widget class extending SugarWidgetField that provides HTML for a delete button in subpanels.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML string for the delete link/button in the subpanel, with context-specific identifiers and confirmation handling.
